name: MERCURY x402 web-fetch content attestation
messageTemplate:
mercury-x402:fetch-attestation:v1
url=<final url>
status=<upstream http status>
sha256=<0x… sha256 hex of `text`>
fetchedAt=<iso8601>
nonce=<0x… 16 random bytes>
howToVerify: 1) recompute sha256(response.text) → must equal attestation.contentHash. 2) reconstruct the message from the template using the response fields. 3) EIP-191 ecrecover the signature over that message → must equal this address. No call back to MERCURY is needed; the receipt is portable + verifiable forever.
